source_data.process: Mineral-oil fluid is atomized using compressed CO2 from a separate external supply; CO2 consumption is documented as 0.18 kg/h at 1.38 bar (20 psi). No onboard compressor is claimed; this is a haze atomizer, not a CO2 plume jet.
